journal_lines: Found something green in the old shaft. Not iron. Not copper. Something better.
The vein in the abandoned tunnel was not what anyone expected. Took it.
Deep in the old workings: green stone. Someone stopped digging too soon.
The abandoned shaft went to exactly the right depth. They missed this by two paces.
Old mine, wrong kind of miners. They were looking for iron. Found something better.
The emerald was half-exposed in the tunnel wall. Someone swung their pick and walked away.
Green stone at the end of a dead-end shaft. Worth every step of the dead end.
The ore changes when you go deep enough. These miners stopped before it did.
Three emeralds in the rotted cart. The miners never got to unload it.
The shaft smelled like old work and new possibility. Both were correct.
Green light from the wall in the dark section. Investigated. Correct instinct.
Found it in the rubble from someone else's collapse. Their loss.
